Entry Slave Markets of Essos In cities where slavery was prevalent, people were priced based on age, skill, appearance, and physical strength. Buyers talk about efficiency and profit, slave traders talk about legal business, and the sold only remember their names, hometowns and the moment when they lost their choice; this prosperity is a miracle for many people. Any break in the place of origin, checkpoints, shipping schedules, debts and protection fees will immediately make the nobles in the distance feel the changes in price and power.
